CheckTitle: Cloudflare R2 bucket custom domains require TLS 1.2 or higher
Description: **Cloudflare R2 bucket custom domains** are assessed for their **minimum TLS version**. Custom domains without an explicit setting accept TLS 1.0.
Risk:
Accepting **TLS 1.0 or 1.1** allows clients to connect using deprecated protocols.
- **Confidentiality**: weak protocol versions are vulnerable to downgrade and known cryptographic attacks
- **Compliance**: PCI DSS and NIST guidance require TLS 1.2 or higher

Code.Other:
1. Log in to the Cloudflare dashboard and select your account
2. Go to R2 Object Storage and select the bucket
3. Open Settings > Custom Domains
4. Edit each domain and set Minimum TLS version to 1.2 or 1.3
5. Save the changes
Code.Terraform:
```hcl
resource "cloudflare_r2_custom_domain" "example" {
  account_id  = "<ACCOUNT_ID>"
  bucket_name = "example-bucket"
  domain      = "assets.example.com"
  zone_id     = "<ZONE_ID>"
  enabled     = true
  min_tls     = "1.2" # Critical: reject TLS 1.0 and 1.1
}
```

Recommendation.Text:
Require **TLS 1.2 or higher** on every custom domain that serves R2 content.
- Prefer TLS 1.3 where clients support it
- Set the minimum TLS version explicitly instead of relying on the default

Notes: Only enabled custom domains are evaluated. Buckets without custom domains are not reported.
